targets.title: Place the Absolute Zero Shard inside the rocket thrusters in Museum Infinitum. If done correctly, a countdown will be hear…
targets.description: Place the Absolute Zero Shard inside the rocket thrusters in Museum Infinitum. If done correctly, a countdown will be heard. Activate the trap and bring O.S.C.A.R. to the rocket thrusters to kill it.

targets.title: Place the Damaged Drone, Car Battery and Aberrant Wiring inside the trap at the Luminarium to enable the Electro-Volt Proj…
targets.description: Place the Damaged Drone, Car Battery and Aberrant Wiring inside the trap at the Luminarium to enable the Electro-Volt Projector. Bring O.S.C.A.R. inside the room and interact with the trap to kill it. Players have to hold O.S.C.A.R. within the room until it overheats and explodes. Purple-eyed zombies will also spawn during this step.

targets.description: Bring O.S.C.A.R. beneath the telescope and interact with the organ in front of the Pack-a-Punch machine. A screen will appear and you'll need to place the cursor on the Sun to activate the trap. Make sure O.S.C.A.R. stays within the laser beam to kill it.

targets.title: The Stellar Dissector can be found next to the trap in Luminarium
targets.description: The Stellar Dissector can be found next to the trap in Luminarium

targets.title: Acquire the LGM-1 (see Key Features for the full trap sequence).
targets.description: Acquire the LGM-1 (see Key Features for the full trap sequence).

targets.title: Travel to the Observatory Dome and enter the 3-digit code into the terminal. If done correctly, a lift will drop down next…
targets.description: Travel to the Observatory Dome and enter the 3-digit code into the terminal. If done correctly, a lift will drop down next to the Pack-a-Punch.

targets.title: Retrieve the key from the corpse on the lift, then travel to Machina Astralis and interact with the cryopod located in the…
targets.description: Retrieve the key from the corpse on the lift, then travel to Machina Astralis and interact with the cryopod located in the adjacent room leading to Scholar's Way. The pod will open, revealing Dr. Thurston's corpse. Note that this will summon O.S.C.A.R. and spawn several zombies to your location.

targets.title: Travel to Museum Infinitum and find the Rock Saw located behind a glass display; shoot the glass to pick it up. Return to …
targets.description: Travel to Museum Infinitum and find the Rock Saw located behind a glass display; shoot the glass to pick it up. Return to the cryopod and interact with the corpse to collect Thurston's brain. You can pick up the Rock Saw before Step 4. Once the cryopod is opened, hold interact on Thurston's head to collect his brain — you will be immune to damage during the process.

targets.title: Travel to The Luminarium and interact with the brain jar on the table to replace the monkey brain with Thurston's brain. I…
targets.description: Travel to The Luminarium and interact with the brain jar on the table to replace the monkey brain with Thurston's brain. Interact once more, and this will trigger a short lockdown where you need to defend the brain.

targets.title: Pick the brain jar up and place it in the machine near the portal in Machina Astralis. Holding the jar will slow you down.…
targets.description: Pick the brain jar up and place it in the machine near the portal in Machina Astralis. Holding the jar will slow you down. Hold interact on the machine to connect the jar to it. If done correctly, the machine will power up and display a list of book titles on the left screen (9 possible titles).

targets.title: Go to the Archive of Orbis. Inside the room there are three busts, each with a set of 3 bookshelves beside it. Interacting…
targets.description: Go to the Archive of Orbis. Inside the room there are three busts, each with a set of 3 bookshelves beside it. Interacting with each bookshelf displays one of the book titles. Find the book titles shown by the machine, then as fast as possible , interact with each bust as many times as the number of matching titles found in its set of shelves. Example: if the machine shows The Black Veil, Echoes of Andromeda, Witchlight Codex, Silence at Singularity, interact with bust 1 once, bust 2 once, bust 3 twice.

targets.title: If done correctly, a panel will open above the ladder in the room. Climb it to retrieve the Neptune model and place it in …
targets.description: If done correctly, a panel will open above the ladder in the room. Climb it to retrieve the Neptune model and place it in the display at the top of Machina Astralis.

targets.title: Find three pages around the map; each page shows a random planet (e.g. Mars) and a random direction (e.g. NE): one on a ta…
targets.description: Find three pages around the map; each page shows a random planet (e.g. Mars) and a random direction (e.g. NE): one on a table in The Luminarium (same room as the Stellar Dissector trap), one on a desk in Machina Astralis, one on the large table in Archive of Orbis.

targets.title: Shoot the corresponding planets (Mars, Saturn, Neptune) on the model display to align each in the direction from the notes…
targets.description: Shoot the corresponding planets (Mars, Saturn, Neptune) on the model display to align each in the direction from the notes. The compass showing the directions is below the Sun model.

targets.title: Travel to the Observatory Dome and interact with the telescope. Look for Mars and note its declination (DEC) — this corres…
targets.description: Travel to the Observatory Dome and interact with the telescope. Look for Mars and note its declination (DEC) — this corresponds to a 4-digit code.

targets.title: On the second floor of Machina Astralis, enter the code into the machine. If done correctly, Thurston will acknowledge the…
targets.description: On the second floor of Machina Astralis, enter the code into the machine. If done correctly, Thurston will acknowledge the successful code input.

targets.title: Interact with the machine to reboot the portal. This spawns O.S.C.A.R., who constantly launches flying saucers at the port…
targets.description: Interact with the machine to reboot the portal. This spawns O.S.C.A.R., who constantly launches flying saucers at the portal to damage it. Destroy the saucers and defend the portal until it finishes rebooting — if it takes too much damage before the timer runs out, the step fails. If done correctly, you will be teleported to Mars automatically.

targets.title: While on Mars, pick up Thurston's brain jar in the center of the arena and place it in the machine at the top of the stair…
targets.description: While on Mars, pick up Thurston's brain jar in the center of the arena and place it in the machine at the top of the stairs. Interact with it to create a portal. (Step 6 of the cheat sheet can be done as you create the portal.)

targets.title: Interact with the machine to play music (once per round). When the music plays, the Ascendant Eye will be seen flying near…
targets.description: Interact with the machine to play music (once per round). When the music plays, the Ascendant Eye will be seen flying near the giant head outside the map.

targets.title: Shoot the four pylons outside the map in order: Back Right, Back Left, Front Right, Front Left , then the pylon above the …
targets.description: Shoot the four pylons outside the map in order: Back Right, Back Left, Front Right, Front Left , then the pylon above the machine on top of the temple to bring the Ascendant Eye into the arena. Shooting the temple pylon repeatedly keeps the music playing, forcing the Ascendant Eye to stay.

targets.title: Wait for the Ascendant Eye to fly low in the arena, then jump and interact to grab it. Easier with low gravity enabled.
targets.description: Wait for the Ascendant Eye to fly low in the arena, then jump and interact to grab it. Easier with low gravity enabled.

targets.title: Place the Ascendant Eye in the device on the right side of the arena. With the LGM-1, shoot the antennas on the five pilla…
targets.description: Place the Ascendant Eye in the device on the right side of the arena. With the LGM-1, shoot the antennas on the five pillars around the arena — each plays a note and displays a symbol on its pillar.

targets.title: Back in the Observatory Dome, interact with the organ. The screen on the right displays the five symbols in order, with on…
targets.description: Back in the Observatory Dome, interact with the organ. The screen on the right displays the five symbols in order, with one hidden behind distorted wave lines. This step can be done immediately after unlocking Pack-a-Punch.

targets.title: Return to Mars and interact with the pillars in the order shown on the organ's screen, inserting the missing symbol where …
targets.description: Return to Mars and interact with the pillars in the order shown on the organ's screen, inserting the missing symbol where indicated. If done correctly, the screen brightens and a quote from Thurston plays.

targets.title: Interact with the machine at the top of the stairs to start the fight against Caltheris .
targets.description: Interact with the machine at the top of the stairs to start the fight against Caltheris .

targets.title: Phase 1 — Kill zombies while dodging Caltheris's lasers to charge the Tesla coil on the right side of the arena. Once full…
targets.description: Phase 1 — Kill zombies while dodging Caltheris's lasers to charge the Tesla coil on the right side of the arena. Once fully charged, interact with the machine at the top of the stairs to fire a beam, instantly draining 1/3 of her health bar. Repeat two more times. After each successful attack, Caltheris gains a new attack: meteors covering an area in flames, or toxic gas on the lower area (draining health to exactly 175 HP) while summoning toxic zombies.

targets.description: Sprint and wall jump to the left side of the asteroid. If done correctly, you will float into space and travel back to the Crash Site. As you travel, the DG-2 Turret will spawn; interact with it as you pass to grab it. While you travel a new mix of "Pareidolia" by Brian Tuey will play.

targets.description: After a few seconds, the shot from the Mangler Cannon will leave the portal going towards Archive of Orbis. You need to gather a group of zombies inside the red circle on the ground near the portal, using Decoys for example.

targets.description: Get Energy Mine and trigger a mine next to Ol' Tessie. If done correctly, the headlights will flash three times signaling the start of a sequence. Afterwards each of the headlights and brake lights will light up. This will be the order for the chandeliers in Museum Infinitum.

targets.description: The two chandeliers near the doorway to Stargazer's Courtyard are the headlights, while the two chandeliers near the doorway to Crash Site are the brake lights.

targets.title: Wall jump to reach the chandeliers to put out the candles, in the order shown by Ol' Tessie.
targets.description: Wall jump to reach the chandeliers to put out the candles, in the order shown by Ol' Tessie.
